title_lines: ROME, 19 BC 🏛️💧 The new aqueduct must fall steadily —
one perfect, unchanging slope for fifty miles,
or the water stops. Find that slope by ear. 🎧
question: Which sound is a steady, unchanging slope? 🏛️
hint_lines: A steady slope LEANS the whole orchestra evenly —
low voices on one side, high on the other, A440 in the middle. 💡
A pit or a peak curves. A road just leans.

options.label: A
options.explain: That land was perfectly FLAT — every musician sang the very same note. A flat channel carries no water. 🙂

options.label: C
options.explain: That was a PIT — the whole chord sat low and rose all around you. Water would pool there, never flow. 🙂

options.label: D
options.explain: That was a HILLTOP — every note hung high, falling away on all sides. Water would scatter, not follow. 🙂

success_text: AQUA FLUIT! 💧 A slope that never changes — the orchestra leans evenly and keeps its shape wherever you walk. That is a plane: the gradient is the same everywhere. 🎉
